candidates.title: From Pixels to Actions - Towards Native Vision-Language-Action Policies
candidates.title_zh: 从像素到动作：面向原生视觉-语言-动作策略
candidates.abstract: Vision-language-action models are typically built on a simple premise: perception is first compressed by visual encoders, and action reasoning begins only afterwards. Yet manipulation often hinges on precisely the visual signals most vulnerable to this abstraction, e.g., local geometry, boundaries, depth, and subtle state changes. This raises a fundamental question: should action policies inherit a fixed visual endpoint, or directly access evolving visual computation? We introduce NEO-VLA, a structurally encoder-free vision-language-action framework. Images are tokenized by lightweight patch convolutional layers and evolve jointly with language throughout the backbone, allowing a flow-matching action expert to draw from instruction-conditioned visual representations at different depths. This simple change reveals a consistent pattern. Native architectures outperform encoder-based counterparts under controlled comparisons; full fine-tuning reduces but does not erase the gap, and additional scale alone cannot recover it. More strikingly, layer-wise probing shows that the action-critical signals often peak well before the final visual representation. Across diverse manipulation settings and distribution shifts, NEO-VLA consequently achieves stronger and more robust control. Together, these results suggest that embodied control benefits from access to visual representations across the computational hierarchy, rather than a fixed encoder output.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出无编码器VLA框架NEO-VLA，图像经轻量patch卷积与语言在骨干中联合演化，动作专家利用多深度视觉表示；在多种操作与分布偏移下实现更强更稳健控制。
candidates.contribution_zh: 去除固定视觉编码器，让动作策略直接访问层级化视觉计算，并通过分层探测揭示动作关键信号常早于最终表示。

candidates.title: Reinforcement Learning Enables Scaling Generalist Robot Policy Improvement
candidates.title_zh: 强化学习驱动通用机器人策略的规模化自我改进
candidates.abstract: The introduction of generalist robot policies has enabled a single, large model to learn to perform a variety of tasks from a vast pre-training corpus. While these models often exhibit powerful zero-shot generalization capabilities, they typically require an adaptation phase to achieve sufficient performance in deployment. Iterated self-improvement via reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated promise in enabling this adaptation, yet such approaches have been largely explored in single-task settings - where the goal is to simply improve on a narrow deployment task - which lies in stark contrast to the multi-task capabilities of the base policy. In this work we ask whether generalist robot policies are capable of multi-task, generalist improvement in deployment - targeting many diverse tasks simultaneously - and what algorithmic recipe enables this. To answer this question, we first develop a set of structured evaluations to test generalist improvement capabilities, and systematically evaluate algorithmic and practical design choices regarding value estimation, policy extraction and resource allocation. We show that not only can generalist policies be improved online across diverse tasks, but that the right recipe can enable generalization and increase performance on tasks not considered during online training. We characterize when this generalization occurs and show that both the training task distribution and the use of value-based RL are critical. To the best of our knowledge, this is among the first evidence for online generalist improvement for robot foundation models.
candidates.summary_zh: 论文系统研究通用机器人策略能否在部署中实现多任务在线强化学习改进，构建结构化评测，并分析价值估计、策略提取与资源分配等设计选择，发现合理方案可带来跨任务乃至未见任务的泛化提升。
candidates.contribution_zh: 首次较系统地给出机器人基础模型在线通用自我改进的证据，并识别价值型强化学习与训练任务分布是泛化关键。

candidates.title: Motion-guided Contrastive Regularization For Latent World Models
candidates.title_zh: 运动引导的潜世界模型对比正则化
candidates.abstract: JEPA-style world models learn action-conditioned latent dynamics without reconstructing observations, but distributional regularization alone does not ensure that their representations preserve information needed for control. We identify static collapse, a failure mode in which the encoder preserves episode-specific static content while suppressing manipulation-relevant state changes. Because static content is temporally predictable yet diverse across episodes, this failure can persist despite regularizers such as SIGReg. A controlled study on OGBench-Cube shows that introducing randomized backgrounds substantially degrades planning performance while leaving the underlying manipulation task unchanged. To address this problem, we propose motion-guided contrastive regularization. Our approach compares predicted latent transitions with transitions to candidate observations from the same episode, reducing the usefulness of static background identity for distinguishing action outcomes. Optical-flow similarities provide soft contrastive targets, allowing candidates with similar motion to receive similar supervision. Combined with latent prediction and SIGReg, our objective encourages representations to preserve within-episode state distinctions and similarities between related transitions. Our method improves planning success over LeWorldModel (LeWM) from 52% to 78% on OGBench-Cube with randomized backgrounds and from 14% to 54% on LIBERO-Object, while maintaining comparable performance on four other visual-control benchmarks.
candidates.summary_zh: 针对JEPA式世界模型的静态坍缩问题，提出运动引导对比正则化，利用光流软目标约束潜转移，提升随机背景下的规划成功率。
candidates.contribution_zh: 提出运动引导对比正则化，抑制静态背景信息并保留操控相关状态变化，在OGBench-Cube与LIBERO-Object上显著提升规划表现。

candidates.title: Open-HumanScale: An Open Recipe for Scaling Human and Robot Experience for Embodied Foundation Models
candidates.title_zh: Open-HumanScale：面向具身基础模型的人类与机器人经验扩展开放配方
candidates.abstract: Egocentric human video offers a scalable source of manipulation priors for robot learning, yet translating raw data scale into generalizable robot policies demands rigorous data curation and training recipes. We introduce Open-HumanScale, the first fully open recipe for scaling egocentric pretraining to 50,000 hours, anchored by Open-HumanScale-50K---a curated egocentric video corpus densely annotated with hand motion and natural language. Leveraging this corpus, we systematically investigate pure human pretraining via closed-loop simulation evaluations and uncover an empirical log-linear scaling law linking pretraining data hours to downstream robot success rates. Grounded in these findings, we develop HumanWAM-Vanilla, a world--action model pretrained exclusively on 50k hours of egocentric human video. Upon robot post-training, HumanWAM-Vanilla reaches 92.08% success on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean2Clean and 68.88% on Clean2Random, alongside a 14.17% mean success rate and a 19.00 mean progress score on RoboDojo. To push the capability frontier further, we explore joint human--robot pretraining with HumanWAM-Goal, a visual-goal-conditioned world--action model. Hybrid data scaling unlocks broad zero-shot generalization across both simulation and physical benchmarks, propelling post-trained RoboTwin 2.0 performance to new state-of-the-art levels: 92.70% on Clean2Clean and a substantial leap to 84.60% on Clean2Random. On physical robots, HumanWAM-Goal further exhibits emergent embodied in-context learning, dynamically adapting its manipulation behavior to unseen visual goals without parameter updates. To support reproducible scaling research in embodied AI, we open-source the Open-HumanScale-50K corpus, data curation and pretraining pipelines, alongside the pretrained and post-trained HumanWAM checkpoints, inference code, and simulation evaluation suites.
candidates.summary_zh: 构建5万小时第一视角人类视频语料与开放预训练流程，发现数据规模与机器人成功率呈对数线性关系，并提出人类视频预训练的世界-动作模型HumanWAM。

candidates.title: Where Is VLA Inference Time Spent? Bottlenecks and Optimization Interactions Across GPUs
candidates.title_zh: VLA推理时间花在哪？跨GPU的瓶颈与优化交互
candidates.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models map camera observations and language instructions to robot actions. However, their large backbones and repeated action generation can make inference take longer than the robot's real-time requirements for its next action. To reduce the load of VLA computations, researchers have proposed multiple optimization approaches, including quantization and pruning. These optimizations can be combined with other general optimizations such as better kernel compilation or using CUDA graphs instead of the eager mode. However, most of these optimization results are usually reported on a single GPU type, typically for a few VLA models, with no analysis of what the real bottlenecks are for a model on a particular hardware or how these optimizations would generalize beyond the reported results. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive measurement study of seven families of inference optimization methods, from CUDA graphs and compilation to token pruning and quantization, on seven state-of-the-art VLAs evaluated on four GPU families ranging from a datacenter H100 to an embedded Jetson Thor. We analyse how CPU launch overhead, memory bandwidth, and kernel efficiency jointly shape optimization gains, and how applying one method changes the benefit of another. From this analysis, we derive VLA-Triage, guidelines for stacking optimizations under latency budgets. The guidelines identify which stages can provide the required savings and which combinations need testing in the deployed execution mode.
candidates.summary_zh: 在四种GPU与七个先进VLA上系统测量七类推理优化，分析CPU启动开销、内存带宽和内核效率如何共同影响加速，并揭示优化叠加效应。
candidates.contribution_zh: 提供跨硬件的VLA推理瓶颈测量与优化叠加分析，提出延迟预算下组合优化的VLA-Triage指南。

candidates.title: Detecting Silent Action-Interface Mismatch with Calibrated Relational World Models
candidates.title_zh: 用校准关系世界模型检测静默动作接口错配
candidates.abstract: A robot action can satisfy shape and range constraints yet carry the wrong semantics: axes may be permuted, signs inverted, rotations rescaled, or gripper polarity reversed. We study learned state-action-effect relations as offline contracts for detecting these mismatches and ranking their likely fields. Clean held-out transitions calibrate alarms; a fixed inverse vocabulary supports closed-set localization. On ten LIBERO Spatial tasks comprising 432 source episodes, a capacity-controlled comparison at 2.5% empirical clean false-positive rate gives 46.1% recall for a ridge forward residual, 61.0% for a four-component joint Gaussian mixture, and 65.7% for the exact conditional of that same mixture. The joint score retains a 14.9 percentage-point advantage over ridge, while conditioning improves recall by a further 4.7 points. Joint scoring instead has higher localization: 95.8% versus 94.6%. These matched-rate comparisons are retrospective diagnostics, not deployment calibration guarantees. Earlier Object/Goal results broaden tasks within the LIBERO convention; DROID, all three HYDRA tasks, short temporal faults, small offsets, exact repair, and simulated mitigation fail their respective gates, while xArm contributes one task only. The evidence supports a bounded offline diagnostic and a detection-localization tradeoff, rather than joint-density superiority or cross-robot safety.
candidates.summary_zh: 论文将学习到的状态-动作-效应关系作为离线契约，检测轴置换、符号反转、旋转缩放和夹爪极性等静默动作接口错配，并在LIBERO任务上校准报警与定位。
candidates.contribution_zh: 提出校准关系世界模型用于动作接口错配检测与字段定位，报告匹配误报率下的检测-定位权衡，并明确跨机器人安全证据有限。

candidates.title: Interactive World Simulation with Cosmos for Physical AI
candidates.title_zh: 面向物理AI的Cosmos交互式世界仿真
candidates.abstract: We present a shared framework that adapts Cosmos world foundation models for real-time interactive world simulation in Physical AI. By streaming visual observations in response to actions and scene controls, the framework enables users and embodied agents to interact with evolving virtual environments. It supports both predicting the visual consequences of actions and generating observations from physical state maintained by an external simulator. We demonstrate this approach across camera navigation and robot manipulation, controllable video transfer, and multi-view autonomous vehicle (AV) simulation. These examples provide a shared foundation for developing interactive virtual environments for Physical AI training and evaluation. Our code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/nvidia/cosmos and https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3-examples. The project website is available at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos-simulation.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出共享框架，将Cosmos世界基础模型改造为实时交互式世界仿真器，按动作与场景控制流式生成视觉观测，支持动作后果预测与外部仿真器物理状态驱动生成，并在相机导航、机器人操作、可控视频转换和多视角自动驾驶仿真中验证。

candidates.title: MKD2World: A Typed Spatial MarkDown World Model For Web Agents
candidates.title_zh: MKD2World：面向网页智能体的类型化空间 Markdown 世界模型
candidates.abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents can improve decision-making with world-model foresight, provided that predicted states accurately reflect post-action interfaces. Existing state representations fail to jointly capture interface layout, UI semantics, and explicit locations. We introduce Typed Spatial Markdown (TSM), a Markdown-style textual state representation for desktop web interfaces. TSM serializes block-level and atomic-level UI elements according to their spatial relationships, jointly encoding their types, visual semantics, explicit locations, optional control states, and hierarchical membership. To train a screenshot-to-TSM renderer, we construct AtomBlock-WebUI, a dataset with precise annotations at both granularities. By injecting element-type labels into HTML and directly extracting bounding boxes after rendering, we avoid annotation errors caused by post-hoc inference from webpage structures. Building on TSM, we propose MKD2World, a desktop web world model trained in two stages for current-state description and action-conditioned next-state prediction. During inference, the web agent queries MKD2World as needed and performs a ``digest'' step, in which it interprets each predicted state and extracts task-relevant evidence for selecting the best action. Experiments show that MKD2World-9B achieves an EleF1 score of 26.50 on the out-of-domain test set, outperforming GPT-5.6-Sol(14.98) by 11.52 points. Across Online-Mind2Web tasks, MKD2World-9B improves the success rate of the Qwen3.5-35B web agent from 22.94% to 37.61%, achieving competitive performance among leading open-source GUI world models. Code is available at https://github.com/OmniAI-Lab-CUHKSZ/MKD2World.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出类型化空间 Markdown（TSM）文本状态表示，按空间关系序列化网页 UI 元素，并构建 AtomBlock-WebUI 数据集训练截图到 TSM 的渲染器；在其上训练两阶段网页世界模型 MKD2World，用于当前状态描述与动作条件下一状态预测。
candidates.contribution_zh: 提出融合布局、语义与显式坐标的 TSM 网页状态表示及精确标注数据集，并构建可动作条件预测的桌面网页世界模型，提升 GUI 智能体决策。

candidates.title: $A^3$-VLA: Automatic Perception-Guided Attention Alignment for Robot Manipulation
candidates.title_zh: A^3-VLA：面向机器人操作的自动感知引导注意力对齐
candidates.abstract: Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) enable robots to perform manipulation tasks by leveraging Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to process visual observations and language instructions. However, the action prediction objective itself lacks fine-grained task-specific perceptual supervision, making it prone to relying on task-irrelevant visual shortcuts, leading attention away from target objects and key interaction areas, thereby limiting its operational performance and generalization ability. To address this, we propose Automatic Perception-Guided Attention Alignment for Robot Manipulation ($A^3$-VLA), a framework that derives task-specific visual guidance from the manipulation process itself. Specifically, $A^3$-VLA first generates heuristic candidate regions for target objects and the robot from interaction-induced visual changes, and refines them with a visual segmentation model offline. These regions serve as explicit perceptual guidance through two complementary objectives: an attention allocation loss that encourages sufficient focus on task-critical regions when language or robot state tokens query the visual input, and a contrastive learning loss that aligns the representations of candidate target regions with language instructions while separating them from task-irrelevant regions. Extensive experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that $A^3$-VLA consistently improves multiple VLA backbones, with an average success rate gain of 6.5% - 25.2% across benchmarks.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出A^3-VLA，从操作交互视觉变化中提取目标与机器人区域作为感知引导，通过注意力分配和对比学习损失对齐视觉与语言，提升多类VLA在仿真和真实操作任务的成功率。
candidates.contribution_zh: 自动生成任务相关区域并引入注意力分配与对比损失，改善VLA感知聚焦和泛化，在仿真与真实操作中稳定提升成功率。

candidates.title: Can Astra Solve RoboMME without Breaking the Bank?
candidates.title_zh: Astra 能否低成本解决 RoboMME？
candidates.abstract: Robotic manipulation often requires remembering information that is no longer visible, such as an object's location before occlusion or the order of a demonstrated action sequence. A large vision-language planner can read this history, but calling it before every action chunk is slow and costly. We present a three-tier system for the RoboMME benchmark. GPT-6 Astra (System 2) selects a grounded subtask from stored visual history, a $π_{0.5}$ vision-language-action policy (System 1) executes it, and a fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-4B monitor (System 1.5) checks after each action chunk whether the subtask is finished. The instruction is kept until the monitor reports completion or a task-specific event occurs, while the policy keeps acting on new observations. On RoboMME, the system succeeds in 79.13% of episodes with an average of 3.63 Astra calls and 80.84 seconds per episode. This is 34.62 points above the best published non-oracle baseline and 4.95 points below GroundSG+Oracle, which gives the low-level policy ground-truth subgoals.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出三层系统：GPT-6 Astra 规划子任务，π0.5 VLA 执行，Qwen3-VL-4B 监控完成；在 RoboMME 达 79.13% 成功率。
candidates.contribution_zh: 以稀疏调用大规划器加轻量监控降低长时程 VLA 操作成本，并显著超越非 oracle 基线。

candidates.title: ReactWorld: Structuring Interaction Responses for Embodied Video Generation
candidates.title_zh: ReactWorld：为具身视频生成结构化交互响应
candidates.abstract: Embodied video world models predict scene changes caused by robot actions, yet generated object responses may remain inconsistent with task intent and contact dynamics. Critical responses in embodied scenes often concentrate in local regions and specific time intervals. Inspired by chain-of-thought reasoning, we introduce ReactWorld, an embodied video generation model guided by structured interaction anticipation. In the generation backbone's feature space, an interaction response field predictor anticipates how the interaction will unfold, explicitly describing participant roles, future motion response intensity, and local motion changes. A response feedback adapter forms increments to object features from the difference between the object branch's outputs with predicted and zeroed local dynamics inputs. It also converts predicted displacements into positional biases for temporal attention. These two mechanisms guide object feature updates and information retrieval across frames, respectively. Through interaction anticipation and generative feedback, ReactWorld achieves an average score of 77.51 on RBench, outperforming PhysisForcing by 3.29 points with improvements in all nine categories. On EZS-Bench, it achieves a Domain score of 86.98 and an average score of 81.87.
candidates.summary_zh: ReactWorld 是动作条件具身视频世界模型，用交互响应场预测参与者角色、未来运动强度与局部变化，并通过响应反馈适配器引导物体特征更新与跨帧注意力，提升生成响应与任务意图、接触动力学的一致性。
candidates.contribution_zh: 提出结构化交互预期引导的具身视频生成框架，以响应场预测和反馈适配器增强动作-物体响应一致性，在 RBench 与 EZS-Bench 上取得提升。

candidates.title: TouchéWorld tech report : Towards Online Unified Camera--Hand Exploration in Generative Worlds
candidates.title_zh: TouchéWorld 技术报告：面向生成世界中的在线统一相机—手部探索
candidates.abstract: Recent video world models allow users to explore generated environments through camera navigation. Continuous hand motion provides a fine-grained action channel for interacting with the people and objects encountered during exploration. We present TouchéWorld, a framework that integrates gesture-driven interaction into a camera-controlled video world model. Given an initial image and a scene-description prompt, the model generates video conditioned on temporally aligned camera and hand controls. We construct joint camera--hand training data from heterogeneous egocentric videos through annotation completion, consistency-based filtering, and temporal alignment. Building on a pretrained camera-controlled world model, we combine spatial hand-skeleton conditioning with numerical hand-motion features through parameter-efficient adaptation. Causal adaptation and few-step distillation support chunk-level online generation, allowing users to update their controls based on generated visual feedback. We further introduce TouchéBench to evaluate hand-motion following, camera--hand coordination, online interaction, and object response. Together, these components establish a framework for studying continuous exploration and hand-driven interaction within generative worlds.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出TouchéWorld，在相机控制的视频世界模型中联合手部骨架与运动条件，支持在线相机—手部探索交互，并构建TouchéBench评测手部跟随、协调与物体响应。

candidates.title: MotoVerse: A Benchmark for Predictive Perception of Motorized Two-Wheelers in Dense Unstructured Traffic
candidates.title_zh: MotoVerse：密集非结构化交通中两轮机动车预测感知基准
candidates.abstract: Motorized Two-Wheelers (MTWs) dominate personal transport across much of the Global South, yet remain largely overlooked in predictive perception research for autonomous driving and ADAS. We introduce MotoVerse, a benchmark for predictive perception from an MTW's ego-centric perspective. MotoVerse comprises 949 maneuver clips collected in dense, unstructured traffic and trajectory annotations for over 31,000 surrounding road agents, including over 16,000 MTWs, enabling two complementary tasks: Ego-Rider Maneuver Anticipation (ERMA) and Traffic Agent Trajectory Prediction (TATP). Each clip is further annotated with an MTW-specific challenge taxonomy comprising dynamic ego-motion, weak traffic structure and contextual occlusion, enabling challenge-aware evaluation. We benchmark established conventional prediction models, general-purpose Vision-Language Models (VLMs), driving-specific VLMs and vision-language-action models. Our experiments reveal three key insights: (i) video backbones reach most of their full-observation accuracy from the first fifth of a maneuver, whereas zero-shot VLMs need most of the maneuver to be observed; (ii) zero-shot VLMs, whether general-purpose or driving-specific, largely remain close to simple baselines on both tasks; a preliminary LoRA study shows that adaptation lifts anticipation sharply but leaves trajectory prediction behind conventional models; and (iii) the rider's own motion drives forecasting difficulty: for every model, including a static baseline, errors are highest during left turns and rise under dynamic ego-motion. We believe MotoVerse will serve as a challenging benchmark for safer and more robust predictive AI for intelligent two-wheelers. The dataset and evaluation code are publicly available at https://github.com/VarunIIITH/MotoVerse.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出面向两轮车自我中心视角的预测感知基准，含949段机动片段和3.1万余交通参与者轨迹，设自我机动预判与交通体轨迹预测两项任务。

candidates.title: Does Your Trial Simulator Know What the Drug Does? An Intervention-Blind Test of Interventional Validity on 7,207 Registered Trials
candidates.title_zh: 你的试验模拟器知道药物作用吗？对7,207项注册试验的干预盲法介入有效性检验
candidates.abstract: Patient world models are increasingly proposed as simulators of clinical trials, and recent surveys rank their capabilities on a ladder from temporal prediction to counterfactual rollouts. Position on that ladder is currently assigned by reading papers rather than by measurement. We turn the counterfactual rung into a measured quantity. From 30,119 completed phase 2/3 trials with results posted to ClinicalTrials.gov we construct 9,996 audited within-trial contrasts from 7,207 trials, and we score a simulator on how much of its accuracy depends on knowing which intervention was tested. The instrument is an intervention-blind reference: the same model, trained on the same trials, with every intervention-identifying field withheld. Interventional skill is the error the full model removes relative to that reference. On a temporal split (878 test contrasts from 655 trials) a registry-trained gradient-boosting simulator removes a fifth of the error of a trivial baseline, but its interventional skill is -0.12 (95% CI -0.21 to -0.05): withholding the intervention makes it better, and no alternative featurisation, stratum, temporal cut or same-molecule retrieval yields an interval above zero. A frontier language model reading only the registered protocol has interventional skill 0.20 [0.08, 0.31]; smaller and open-weight models sit at the limit of detection. Perturbation tests show the large model uses the intervention as such: swapping the arms reverses the sign of its prediction in 86% of contrasts. The blind reference is itself not drug-blind (a language model recovers the withheld drug class 45% of the time from the blind prompt), so interventional skill is a conservative lower bound. A reliability layer shows that ranking by predicted error lowers it but that calibrated error control does not transfer under temporal shift. Benchmark, code, prompts and per-call model outputs are released.
candidates.summary_zh: 从7,207项注册临床试验构建9,996个组内对照，用遮蔽干预信息的盲法参照模型测量模拟器的介入技能，发现梯度提升模拟器为负值，前沿语言模型为0.20。
candidates.contribution_zh: 提出基于干预盲法参照的介入有效性可测量指标，并发现多数试验模拟器并未真正利用干预信息。

candidates.title: CellCanon: An Agentic Cellular World Model for Prediction, Explanation, and Observation-Driven Updating
candidates.title_zh: CellCanon：面向预测、解释与观测驱动更新的智能体细胞世界模型
candidates.abstract: Biological discovery requires using molecular knowledge and new measurements to infer responses beyond the conditions already observed. We introduce CellCanon, the first agentic cellular world model to unify single-cell expression prediction, evidence-grounded explanation, and observation-driven updating. Its predictive core reuses condition-level biological evidence across gene-specific numerical readouts to guide single-cell expression generation. A shared world state links predictions, acquired measurements, and source-linked claims, supporting explanation and revision. On 339 held-out SciPlex3 conditions across three cell lines, CellCanon improves differential-expression AUPRC and Macro-F1 over the best baseline for each metric by 63.3% and 17.3%, respectively, and direction Macro-F1 by 7.2%. Relative to gene-wise reasoning on matched drug-cell cohorts, measured language-model token use falls by 99.77% for Predict and 98.41% for Explain. On the source-grounded benchmark, Explain correctly answers all answerable questions with supporting proofs and identifies all insufficient-evidence cases. In simulated experimental feedback, Update uses one measured source context per drug to exceed the best fine-tuned baselines in differential-expression AUPRC and Macro-F1 without changing model weights. Together, these capabilities support a cumulative account of cellular responses, with predictions and biological judgments that can be revised as evidence accumulates.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出智能体式细胞世界模型，统一单细胞表达预测、有证据支撑的解释与基于新观测的更新；在SciPlex3多细胞系条件上显著提升差异表达预测指标，并大幅降低推理token消耗。
candidates.contribution_zh: 以条件级生物证据复用驱动单细胞表达生成，构建共享世界状态连接预测、测量与来源可溯论断，支持无权重更新的证据累积式修正。

candidates.title: Time-to-Goal: Learned Temporal Metrics for Long-Horizon Planning with JEPA World Models
candidates.title_zh: Time-to-Goal：面向JEPA世界模型长程规划的学习式时间度量
candidates.abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) support planning by comparing predicted latent states with an encoded goal. For this comparison to guide temporal progress, states closer in time to the goal should receive lower costs. However, training representations for prediction and distribution regularization does not directly enforce this ordering. We examine this mismatch in flat LeWorldModel (LeWM) by analyzing how its Euclidean goal cost changes with temporal separation. Our analysis identifies conditions under which states at different long offsets receive similar average costs, weakening their temporal distinction. To learn the missing ordering explicitly, we introduce Time-to-Goal (T2G), a lightweight metric trained on latent triples from offline trajectories. A margin ranking loss encourages smaller distances for temporally nearer states, requiring no rewards or policy labels. The learned metric then replaces the Euclidean planning cost while the JEPA encoder and predictor remain frozen. Diagnostics on AntMaze and FourRoom show that T2G preserves stronger temporal contrast and improves near--far ranking at long offsets. Across four navigation and manipulation benchmarks, T2G improves the average planning success rate from 32.7\% (flat LeWM) to 63.0\% and approaches or even surpasses the performance of the hierarchical H-JEPA baselines. These results show that learning temporal ordering for the goal cost can substantially improve latent planning even with a flat world model.
candidates.summary_zh: JEPA世界模型的欧氏目标代价难以区分时间远近；提出轻量Time-to-Goal度量，用离线轨迹隐三元组与排序损失学习时间顺序，替换规划代价后导航与操作基准成功率由32.7%升至63.0%。
candidates.contribution_zh: 提出Time-to-Goal：无需奖励或策略标签，仅用离线轨迹隐状态三元组与边际排序损失学习时间度量，替换JEPA规划的欧氏目标代价，改善长程隐空间规划。

candidates.title: OdorSpaces: Visual-Olfactory Embodied Navigation in 3D Environments
candidates.title_zh: OdorSpaces：三维环境中的视觉-嗅觉具身导航
candidates.abstract: Olfaction provides critical information about airborne chemical cues, yet it remains largely underexplored in embodied AI, with limited prior machine olfaction work focusing primarily on semantic odor perception. We introduce OdorSpaces, a physics-based simulation platform and benchmark for visual-olfactory embodied navigation. OdorSpaces augments Habitat-Sim with 3D odor transport and dispersion simulated by Fire Dynamics Simulator (FDS), enabling agents to navigate photorealistic indoor environments using both visual and olfactory observations. The benchmark includes two representative source-seeking scenarios: invisible gas-leak localization and early-stage fire localization. We develop an initial multimodal reinforcement learning policy that integrates visual observations and olfactory measurements over time. Experiments show that the policy outperforms a diverse set of baselines, establishing a strong reference for future research on visual-olfactory embodied navigation.

candidates.title: Correct Robots Before They Make Mistakes: Proactive Human-in-the-Loop Intervention via Preference Learning
candidates.title_zh: 在机器人犯错前纠正：通过偏好学习的主动人在回路干预
candidates.abstract: This paper presents Proactive Human-in-the-Loop (PHIL), a framework for proactive policy correction and preference-based post-training. PHIL enables operators to preview policy-predicted future motion and intervene before anticipated undesirable actions. During takeover, PHIL continues querying the policy and displaying its predicted trajectories in the physical workspace through an extended reality (XR) interface. PHIL pairs rejected policy predictions with corrective action chunks subsequently executed from the same physical state over the same horizon, and preference-based post-training encourages the policy to favor these corrections. This paper evaluates PHIL on four real-world manipulation tasks using a diffusion policy and a pretrained vision-language-action policy. With five correction episodes per condition, PHIL increases mean success rates across the evaluated tasks and demonstration budgets from 44.0% to 70.3% for the diffusion policy and from 57.8% to 76.9% for X-VLA, compared with HG-DAgger. Separately, policies trained with proactive corrections show fewer unnecessary recovery behaviors in successful episodes. Project page: https://intuitive-robots.github.io/PHIL-page/.
candidates.summary_zh: PHIL 让操作者通过 XR 预览策略预测的未来运动，在不良动作发生前接管，并将被拒绝的预测与纠正动作块配对，用偏好后训练使策略倾向纠正，在四项真实操作任务上提升成功率。

candidates.title: Readable Is Not Steerable: Pre-Registered Tests of Physical Structure in Learned Fluid Representations
candidates.title_zh: 可读不等于可操控：学习流体表示中物理结构的预注册检验
candidates.abstract: Self-supervised world models are often said to organize their latents around physical quantities. We test this on 2D decaying Navier-Stokes flow in three pre-registered studies, each tested once on held-out data. In Study 1, a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) trained to predict the flow fails the pre-registered criteria for organizing its latent around fluid quantities better than an untrained network of the same architecture (not supported); a JEPA trained on non-physical linear dynamics and a static invariance model that never sees time do as well or better. In Study 2, plain autoencoders that render the field make enstrophy prominent in their slowest unsupervised latent directions (best r 0.80-0.86 vs 0.38 untrained; fresh seeds, sealed data). Adding VICReg lowers this prominence in every comparison, though not by the pre-registered margin for vorticity, while raising the autoencoders' linear decodability (partially supported). In Study 3, we build steerable directions ("dials") by routing: the decoder gets overall scale only through a small conditioning code, while its other pathway carries a degraded copy of spectral shape. Label-free rules find a loudness dial in all 8 trained models and a shape dial in 3 of 5 fresh seeds on sealed data, against a pre-registered bar of 4; neither control shows a shape dial (partially supported). Across the studies, what a latent contains and what can be controlled through it come apart. In exploration, a supervised direction reading spectral shape almost perfectly moved nothing when steered. During the build, the loudness dial had to be found by its effect on the output (closest to a pure rescaling), not by data variance; for shape, a variance rule and an effect-constrained rule each worked in 3 of 5 seeds. The program used about 70 logged hours on one consumer GPU; all pre-registrations, deviations, code and outputs are public.
candidates.summary_zh: 论文对二维衰减Navier-Stokes流开展三项预注册实验，检验JEPA与自编码器潜变量是否组织流体物理量，并构建可操控方向，发现表示内容与可控性分离。

candidates.title: Jev with Foresight: Safe Language-Guided Autonomous Driving via a Language World Model
candidates.title_zh: Jev-AD：基于语言世界模型的安全语言引导自动驾驶
candidates.abstract: Large language models understand passengers' driving commands, but as driving agents they reason in generated text for seconds and must infer each action's consequences implicitly from the scene. We present Jev-AD, which pairs Jev, a typed decision model that answers predefined questions with probabilities, not generated text, with a language world model that predicts for every candidate action how nearby vehicles move over the next two seconds. Code turns these predictions into foreseen consequences, which Jev compares instead of inferring them from coordinates. In simulated highway merging (500 car-episodes), this foresight lowers the same decision model's collision rate from 26.0% to 2.4% at 0.25 seconds per decision, and Jev-AD achieves the passenger's intent in 93% of free-form command trials. In 500 replayed real-world NGSIM episodes, foresight lowers the collision rate from 48.2% to 2.8%, and the world model, learned from this traffic, foresees 93% of dangerous actions. Project page: https://ys-qu.github.io/jev-ad-website.

candidates.contribution_zh: 用语言世界模型为候选动作生成预见后果，显著降低碰撞率并提升指令达成率。

candidates.title: SurgTransfer: Multi-Step Latent Action Modeling for Action Transfer in Surgical World Model
candidates.title_zh: SurgTransfer：外科世界模型中的多步潜动作建模与动作迁移
candidates.abstract: Surgical world models have the potential to provide intra-operative guidance, accelerate risk-free training and facilitate transfer of expert surgical maneuvers. However, the use of world models for transferring surgical expertise has been largely unexplored. Moreover, recent approaches in this domain have mainly relied on ground truth kinematics actions or expert annotations for specific tasks, limiting their applicability beyond the narrow range of tasks with ground-truth annotations. In contrast, existing works in the natural domain have shown promising results in learning latent actions solely from unlabeled videos and transferring the learned actions across contexts. We observe that this paradigm is short-sighted for the surgical domain, failing to capture the hierarchical and goal-directed structure of surgical procedures. Thus, we propose a novel multi-step action learning framework to learn context-invariant latent actions that are easily transferable across various surgical contexts. We perform extensive experiments on the publicly available datasets, SurgToolLoc-2022 and PitVis-2023, verifying our approach with both quantitative metrics and qualitative evaluation by surgical experts. We have published our code and the implementation details at https://github.com/bhattarailab/Surgical-Vision-World-Model.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出多步潜动作学习框架，从无标注手术视频学习上下文不变的潜动作，并在不同手术场景间迁移，用公开数据集和专家评估验证。
